caption: The video captures a close, top-down view into a circular vessel whose dark inner walls are bordered by a yellowish outer rim. A ring of thick, brownish-green paste bubbles continuously around a central depression, while a smooth silvery patch of liquid rests on the left side of the ring. Dense white steam fills the central hole, opaque and billowing, obscuring the surface beneath it. As the excerpt progresses, the steam thins and drifts toward the upper right, gradually revealing a dark liquid surface dotted with a few small bubbles inside the center. The camera slowly pulls back, widening the field of view so that more of the circular rim and outer edge become visible. Throughout, the surrounding paste keeps churning at small scale, its overall shape and the left-side reflective patch remaining persistent and stable. The boiling and steaming process is already underway when the clip opens and continues steadily through its final frames.
relations: As steam thins and drifts toward the upper right, a dark liquid surface with small bubbles is revealed.
The churning paste ring and left-side reflective patch persist, maintaining their overall shape throughout the process.
The camera pulling back widens the view, exposing more of the circular rim and yellowish outer edge.
